purpose: Ten separate first-frame art directions for review in Gwenview; user will choose a direction.

variants.name: Photographic studio
variants.direction: Style/medium: excellent natural studio photography of a real adult yoga practitioner. Soft window light, believable skin and fabric, restrained editorial treatment, no airbrushing, grounded human presence. A photograph, not an illustration.
variants.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: one still first frame for an Inner Breeze sun salutation style exploration. Create ONE full-body image of ONE adult woman, natural adult proportions, dark hair tied back, wearing a simple charcoal sports top and charcoal leggings, barefoot on a plain yoga mat. First pose: upright mountain pose with palms together at the center of her chest, feet together and fully grounded, straight but relaxed posture. Strict right-facing side profile, eye-level fixed camera, whole figure and mat fully visible with generous margins above the head and below the feet. Simple quiet neutral light studio background, uncluttered composition. Landscape image, approximately 3:2. Pose clarity and believable anatomy matter. No text, numbering, captions, logo, watermark, panels, collage, contact sheet, sprite sheet, extra figures, or interface. This is a fresh art direction; give the chosen medium a finished, distinctive, carefully art-directed look.
Style/medium: excellent natural studio photography of a real adult yoga practitioner. Soft window light, believable skin and fabric, restrained editorial treatment, no airbrushing, grounded human presence. A photograph, not an illustration.
